data.name: Chauhan
data.long_meaning: Originating from the Rajput clan, Chauhan is a name of great heritage and significance in Hindu culture. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chahana', which means 'to desire or to demand'. Chauhan represents a free and generous spirit, one who is not afraid to ask for what they want and to fight for their rights. This name is often given to boys born into noble families or those who exhibit courage and strength in their character.
